seconds_to_steady for the historical presets is MEASURED: steps_per_sec over 250 steps after a 50-step warm-up on this machine, then the case run to the SS9 visual-steady step count (6,100 steps at the 46.4 r_t compact demo domain, scaled by domain length and by 1/dt) with the wall clock taken. The residual-based settled flag is not usable as a finish line for these cases for the same reason it is not for the demo case -- an overexpanded sea-level plume keeps breathing above the 1e-3 threshold indefinitely.

Every historical preset clears the 0.40 Summerfield separation threshold at its own default altitude; the tightest is Titan I LR87-AJ-3 (1 of 2) at p_e/p_a 0.630. The two altitude-optimised presets are asserted in BOTH directions: Atlas LR105-5 (default 10 km) and Titan I LR91-AJ-3 (default 12 km) must separate at sea level, or their non-zero default would be decoration rather than a fix, and each default must clear its own computed crossing by at least 2 km. Every other preset must NOT separate at 0 km, or it would need a default of its own.

The Rao table covers eps = 4-100 and rao_angles clamps at BOTH ends; the area-ratio slider bottoms out at 2, so all 10 bell presets can be dragged below the table. The UI's disclosure condition is !(4.0..=100.0).contains(eps), which already fires at both ends — verified here rather than assumed, because the natural way to write that check while thinking only about Merlin Vac (eps 165) is to test the high end alone. Below eps 4 the angles are the eps = 4 row (theta_n 21.50, theta_e 14.00 at 80%) stretched to the requested exit radius.

Redstone throat area recovered from the rasterized wall: 0.121785 m^2 at 4x the production radial resolution (+0.041% vs the published 0.121736 m^2), 0.122089 m^2 on the production grid (+0.290%). The production figure is biased HIGH by column averaging: a column integrates the wall over its own width and r(z) is quadratic at a throat, so the cell-mean area exceeds the minimum by ~(dz^2/12)/R_arc. It falls as dz^2, which the refined figure confirms. The preset's own r_t gives a geometric area of 0.121736 m^2 (+0.000%).
